conditionalPolicies.randomEligible: Copied only with truthy outerwearStyling; false is retained. Any unconsumed source value is reported, never silently dropped.
conditionalPolicies.outerwearFastenerRequirement: Copied when !== undefined; empty string is retained.
conditionalPolicies.subjectLight: Object only in CameraLighting / Light Style; nested tags also join final ordered tags.
conditionalPolicies.lyingSurface: Copied as object, including every nested value; source and runtime compared for all rows.
conditionalPolicies.truthyDedicatedFields: outerwear,bottomWaist,topUnderbust,wearableColorTarget,outerwearFit,outerwearStyling,legacyPromptAliases,legacyLabels use current truthy guards. B does not change engine guards. A newly supplied false/0/empty value must be allowed by schema AND demonstrably consumed or integrity fails.
conditionalPolicies.meta: Inferred meta overwritten by explicit source meta then dedicated fields. Nested objects are replaced, not recursively merged; tags use ordered union. Unknown fields fail schema.
